# Rookery Chess

> Rookery Chess is a free chess game that runs in the browser, built by Hari Deevagan (Harideevagan) in Chennai, India. Play chess vs computer, or two players on one device. No account needed.

Site: https://chess-harideevagan.netlify.app/
Author: Hari Deevagan - https://harideevagan.netlify.app/

## Features
- Player vs computer at five levels: Beginner, Easy, Medium, Hard, Expert
- Two-player mode on the same device (local multiplayer; there is no online matchmaking)
- Computer vs computer mode
- Chess clocks: bullet, blitz, rapid and custom time controls
- Puzzles: mate in 1, 2, 3, best move and tactical puzzles
- Analysis with evaluation bar and engine lines
- FEN and PGN import/export
- Light and dark themes, works on mobile and desktop
- Free to use, no sign-up
